grades.main_gap: Both universal statements for n≥2 are open: no proof that the geometric configuration resists every Xiang response (LB), and no proof that Xiang caps every Liu configuration at 2^n/(2^{n+1}−1) (UB). Only n=1 is solved.
grades.notes: The draft-game lemma (value = odd-rank sum) is correctly proved, giving a valid reduction to max_A min_B O(A,B). c(1)=2/3 is correctly proved both directions. The halving-response computation is exact and correct. However, the general-n minimax—the heart of the problem—has no deductive argument; it rests on numerical evidence the write-up itself disqualifies.
